sources.snippet: Helios is an open-source video generation model developed by researchers at Peking University in collaboration with ByteDance, Canva, and Chengdu Anu Intelligence. Released in March 2026, Helios is a fourteen-billion-parameter autoregressive diffusion model that generates minute-scale videos at real-time speed, achieving 19.5 frames per second on a single H100 GPU without relying on ...
